name: Rostec
verdict: Russian state corporation; general sponsor of FC Baltika, main logo on the front of the 2026-27 shirt.
note: Rating note: Rostec is a state corporation created by the Russian Federation (rostec.ru; EU Regulation 2022/581 calls it a state-owned defence conglomerate), and the Russian Federation is at war with Ukraine (russian-federation-record). Propose severe, mirroring the existing Gazprom and Aeroflot ratings (state directly tied to ongoing severe abuses controls/pays for the sponsor).
